source.caption: Alignment between multivariate discriminant structure and model-based importance in the 16PF. (A) Rank-level correspondence between standardized discriminant weights ( | w ~ | ) derived from linear discriminant analysis and SHAP importance. (B) Rank-level correspondence between trait-level contribution terms ( | c i | = | d i w ~ i | ) from the Mahalanobis D 2 decomposition and permutation importance. Each point represents one trait. The dashed red line indicates the identity line (perfect rank agreement). Spearman rank correlations demonstrate strong alignment between multivariate structure and model-based importance.
